name: Waterfall Ring Toss
description: A little world under water. Press two soft pumps, send colored rings drifting through the current, and let them settle onto the pegs. An original pocket toy for patient afternoons.

assets.credit: Original Tideling pocket water toy and miniature illustrations

compatibility: Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, Pointer-compatible native buttons and requestAnimationFrame. No third-party runtime, remote images, WebGL or audio.
Desktop mouse / trackpad, mobile touch, and keyboard. Focus the chamber and use A / D or left / right arrows for the pumps, Space for both. All other actions have ordinary HTML controls.
Fixed 120 Hz simulation, at most 24 rings and 160 bubbles, capped 2× pixel ratio. Native resize preserves world coordinates. No per-ring DOM nodes.

Lab visibility and page visibility pause both physics and challenge time. Reduced motion removes the reset wobble and ambient caustic motion; deliberately activated pumps still animate the essential gameplay.
An original static toy illustration remains available without JavaScript. The game needs Canvas 2D; score and status are accessible HTML.
notes: Tideling is an original toy design with printed harbor, coral reef and moon-pool backdrops. It includes no branded artwork, sound or third-party assets.

Rings receive distributed impulses from separate water jets, then sink with drag and bounded turbulence. Scoring requires a descending crossing of a peg tip with the opening aligned. Catches slide to a visible stack and cannot be knocked off.

This is an intentionally lightweight 2D toy model with illustrative depth, not a fluid solver or rigid-body torus simulation. Slow alternating pumps can clear the board; frantic pumping keeps rings aloft.
Challenge time begins only after Start. Endless mode automatically replenishes the rings 2.2 seconds after every catch. Free play hides the counter without changing the physics.

Changing the layout, chamber shape, mode, count or challenge duration starts a fresh board. Color scenery, turbulence and force changes retain ring positions. Lab presets and setup JSON store controls, not an in-progress game.
reuse: WaterToy in model.js is a DOM-independent fixed-step model with configurable chamber bounds, pegs, ring objects, water jets and scoring rules. Submit pump events and advance elapsed time; read rings, pegs, events and score.

createWaterToy(canvas, settings, hooks) in engine.js manages rendering, resolution, frame timing and cleanup. Hooks accept a neutral scene definition, an optional backdrop renderer, per-frame reports and semantic pump/catch/round/finish events.
The separate renderer, optional Lab UI, original assets and a neutral embed-demo.html ship in the source ZIP. README.md documents inputs, coordinates, lifecycle and limitations.
